text:
sarah_csm: Heads up — ElmThera flagged a spike in p99 latency overnight and asked if this triggers credits. They mentioned onboarding traffic is impacted; want an exec summary + timeline by EOD.

maria_eng: Acknowledged. I'll pull metrics and check for any config changes or rollout around that window.

alex_cs: I can draft the customer comms once we have root cause. Do we have the raw SLO window and credit calc? :thinking_face:

jordan_se: Quick note — saw several large batched rerank jobs at 03:12 UTC that could explain KV cache churn. Will verify correlation.

maria_eng: Raw snapshot (last 24h):
```
uptime: 99.992% (SLO 99.99%)
p50 latency: 120ms
p95 latency: 380ms
p99 latency: 1.2s (SLO p99 <= 500ms)
error rate: 0.12%
```
Looks like p99 breached window ~03:10–03:30 UTC.

priya_pm: If that p99 breach holds against the rolling 30d window we may owe a latency credit per the contract. We should check whether ElmThera is on a latency SLO or just uptime.

alex_cs: ElmThera's contract: uptime SLO + optional latency addendum (they purchased latency tier). Credit formula: prorated credit for minutes over threshold, capped per month. I'll fetch exact numbers from the contract doc and paste in the comms.

jordan_se: Root cause draft: large rerank batch + cache eviction on primary pool under heavy onboarding traffic. Mitigations: pin heavier customers to dedicated pool (short), increase prewarm/replicas on onboarding route (mid), add KV cache guardrails (long).

maria_eng: For immediate mitigation: throttled rerank batching for 10m and warmed replicas — p99 back to 480ms at 03:45 UTC. I'll schedule a rollback of throttle at 05:00 after monitoring.

sarah_csm: Thanks. Customer asks: timeline for credits and whether renewal decision is at risk. Can we confirm credit amount and send a short playbook-style note: what happened, what we did, next steps, credit ETA?

alex_cs: I'll assemble an exec note. Need final confirmation from legal/finance on credit calc. @priya_pm — can you own the ETA to finance (30–60 min)?

priya_pm: On it. Pinged finance via email and internal billing queue. Expect confirmation in ~45m.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-2143 — "ElmThera p99 latency spike". Assigned: eng-oncall.

maria_eng: Final ask — can product ops create a short diagnostic bundle for the customer (graphs + request IDs) so they can validate? I can attach traces.

sarah_csm: Yes please. Customer prefers a concise one-pager + credit calc. I'll hold off on renewal messaging until we have finance number. Thanks team :heart:

alex_cs: Drafting comms now. Will post first pass in ~30m.
